data.name: Sharveer
data.gender_notes: Sharveer is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Sharveer is a combination of two Sanskrit words - Shar and Veer. Shar means the king of the gods and Veer means the brave one. It is a powerful name that represents the supreme power of the gods and the bravery of an individual. The name Sharveer carries the meaning “King of Gods” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Sharveer usually hope their child will grow to embody king of gods and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Sharveer is believed to bring the blessings of Lord Indra, the king of the gods. It is a name that is believed to bestow strength, power, and intelligence on an individual. It is a name that inspires loyalty and courage, and is often given to children who are destined to lead.
data.etymology: Sharveer belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “King of Gods.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sharveer total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
